explanation: Victorian families played it in the 1880s with improvised kit, sometimes a row of books for a net. When the name ping-pong was trademarked, rival makers sold the game as table tennis.

claims.text: Table tennis began in England in the 1880s as an indoor after-dinner game.
Table tennis did not begin in China, Japan or India.
Early players sometimes used household items such as books as a net.
After the name ping-pong was registered as a trademark, other makers sold the game under the name table tennis.
